name: biobb_gromacs InsertMolecules
title: Wrapper of the GROMACS insert-molecules module.
description: The GROMACS insert-molecules module inserts copies of a molecule into the vacant space of an existing structure or into an empty box, ie to build mixed solvent boxes. The topology is not modified: the inserted molecules must be added to it afterwards.

input_insert_gro_path.description: Path to the GRO file of the molecule to insert

file_formats.description: Path to the GRO file of the molecule to insert
Path to the GRO file of the molecule to insert

output_gro_path.description: Path to the output GRO file

file_formats.description: Path to the output GRO file
Path to the output GRO file

input_gro_path.description: Path to the GRO file of the existing structure to insert into. If not provided, the molecules are inserted into an empty box defined by the box property

file_formats.description: Path to the GRO file of the existing structure to insert into. If not provided, the molecules are inserted into an empty box defined by the box property
Path to the GRO file of the existing structure to insert into. If not provided, the molecules are inserted into an empty box defined by the box property

input_positions_dat_path.description: Path to the DAT file with the predefined insertion trial positions (three columns x y z in nm, displacements from the position of the molecule to insert)

file_formats.description: Path to the DAT file with the predefined insertion trial positions (three columns x y z in nm, displacements from the position of the molecule to insert)
Path to the DAT file with the predefined insertion trial positions (three columns x y z in nm, displacements from the position of the molecule to insert)

nmol.description: Number of extra molecules to insert. Ignored if input_positions_dat_path is provided: one molecule is inserted per position.

box.description: Box size in nm as three floats ie "5.0 5.0 5.0". Mandatory if input_gro_path is not provided; if both are provided, a new box is placed around the input structure before the insertions.

tries.description: Number of insertion attempts per molecule (nmol * tries attempts are made before giving up).

seed.description: Seed for random number generator (0 means generate a random seed).

radius.description: Default van der Waals distance in nm, used for atoms not found in the vdwradii.dat database.

scale.description: Scale factor to multiply the van der Waals radii from the vdwradii.dat database.

dr.description: Allowed displacement in nm in x y z from the positions in the input_positions_dat_path file.

property_formats.name: z
property_formats.description: random rotation around the z axis

gmx_lib.description: Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable.

binary_path.description: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.

restart.description: Do not execute if output files exist.

sandbox_path.description: Parent path to the sandbox directory.

container_path.description: Path to the binary executable of your container.

container_volume_path.description: Path to an internal directory in the container.

container_working_dir.description: Path to the internal CWD in the container.

container_user_id.description: User number id to be mapped inside the container.

container_shell_path.description: Path to the binary executable of the container shell.
